styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Ciudad Vieja, markets and the Rambla.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Asado, chivitos and Mercado del Puerto.

styles.label: Beaches
styles.blurb: Rambla walks and summer swims at Pocitos.

stays.why: Old-town squares, Mercado del Puerto and the Buquebus ferry terminal on foot. Lively by day, quiet at night.
Central and good value. Walk to Plaza Independencia and the Rambla; many buses pass through.
Beach neighbourhood on the Rambla. Cafés, safe evening walks and quick rides to the centre.
Leafy, calm and near the airport. Best if you want quiet nights and a garden hotel.

food: Try Uruguayan staples: asado (grilled beef), chivito (a loaded steak sandwich) and milanesa.
Mercado del Puerto near the port is the classic stop for grilled meat; go at lunch, prices are mid to high.
A mate gourd and thermos is the local habit. Buy a cheap set at a market and join in.
Bakeries sell bizcochos and medialunas for a cheap breakfast, about UYU 100–200.
Dinner starts late, often after 21:00. Many restaurants close on Sunday night; check on the day.
more_time: Add a day in Colonia del Sacramento: a UNESCO old town, reachable by Buquebus ferry or bus.
Take a Buquebus ferry across to Buenos Aires if you have a spare day and your papers in order.
Spend a slow afternoon on the Rambla: walk or rent a bike and stop for a coffee by the water.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Ciudad Vieja, the Mercado del Puerto and a Rambla walk; add a night for a beach day in summer.

month_notes: Warm and busy: highs near 26°C, lows near 20°C. Good beach weather; expect about 9 rain days.
Similar to January: warm nights and about 8 rain days. Peak holiday season, book ahead.
Still warm at 24°C, but rainier with about 10 rain days. Carry a light rain jacket.
Cooler: highs near 21°C, lows near 16°C. Pleasant for walking; about 9 rain days.
Mild and drier: highs near 17°C, lows near 12°C, about 7 rain days. Bring a jacket.
Cool start to winter: highs near 15°C, lows near 10°C. About 8 rain days; layers help.
Coldest month: highs near 14°C, lows near 9°C. About 9 rain days; pack warm clothes.
Still cold: highs near 15°C, lows near 9°C. About 8 rain days; indoor sights are best.
Slowly warming: highs near 16°C, lows near 11°C, about 7 rain days. Good for the Rambla.
Warmer at 19°C, but the wettest month with about 10 rain days. Keep plans flexible.
Pleasant: highs near 22°C, lows near 16°C, about 7 rain days. Great for walking and food.
Warm again: highs near 25°C, lows near 18°C, about 8 rain days. Beach days return.

climate_guide.summary: Mild four-season climate with warm summers and cool winters. Rain falls all year, so keep plans flexible.

items.title: Best time: December to March
items.text: Warm days around 24–26°C and mild nights. Best for beaches and the Rambla.

items.title: Cool winters (June to August)
items.text: Highs near 14–15°C and lows near 9–10°C. Bring a warm jacket and layers.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 7–10 rain days every month. October is the wettest. A small umbrella helps.

items.title: Breezy coast
items.text: The Rambla is windy; a light windproof layer is useful even in summer.

items.title: No extreme heat
items.text: Summers are warm, not scorching. Evenings stay comfortable for outdoor dinners.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Summer: light clothes, sunscreen and a hat. Winter: warm layers, a coat and closed shoes.

transit.best: Walk in the centre and use ride apps or buses for longer trips.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Buses are the only mass transit.
Get a free STM card at Abitab; cash fare is about UYU 36, card fares cheaper. STM gives 2 buses in 1 hr for about UYU 29, or unlimited buses in 2 hr for about UYU 44.
Ride apps like Uber work and are often cheaper and safer than street taxis. Taxis are metered; a 10-minute ride costs about UYU 100.
Driving is possible but parking is scarce and expensive. Walking is easier in the centre.
Easy in the centre and along the Rambla. Use buses or apps for longer hops.
Buquebus ferries link Ciudad Vieja with Buenos Aires and Colonia.
